recipes.name: Pink Summer Beer
ingredients_raw: 1 (12 fluid ounce) can frozen pink lemonade concentrate, thawed
1 (12 fluid ounce) can or bottle beer

steps.text: Place lemonade concentrate in a gallon pitcher. Measure water and vodka in the 12 ounce lemonade can and add to the pitcher. Pour in the beer, mix well and serve over ice.

raw_recipe.headline: Pink Summer Beer
raw_recipe.description: This summer beer recipe is fun to make with pink lemonade, vodka, and beer for a crowd-pleasing icy cocktail at summertime gatherings or parties.

review.reviewBody: This is good, alright, but to take it up a notch, use lemon flavored vodka, lime beer, and raspberry lemonade frozen concetrate. Bam! The raspberry lemonade gives it a sweeter taste & is not as acidic. Gone in 60 seconds at a couples shower. Didn't have enough & had to give the recipe to everyone.

This is good, although I think beer margaritas are much better. I used raspberry lemonade concentrate, used water and added sprite to dilute the alcohol since the taste was very strong. I also added fresh raspberries and mint. I highly recommend making it ahead of time and sticking it in the freezer and making a slushy out of it.
I did it a little differently. I used the same frozen lemonade, but filled it once with vodka. Then I put 4 of the regular size cans of bud light. No water. Was so much better.

The beer matters: 1) Go with Amstel Light to keep the lemonade-dominant flavor. 2) Go with Abita "Andy Gator" Lager to tone down the tart lemon and add an extra kick. ... Substitute club soda for water and play with your favorite vodka flavors knowing you will sacrifice proof for those flavors (recommend additive other than flavored vodka!). Don't drive after consumption!
not very good, too much alcool and I had to put twice the amount of lemonade to cover the beer taste. Use a very light beer and not strong one like I did because it will only taste like beer.

Omg....so good!!!! Gone in seconds at recent cookout....had to make 3 batches. I used pink lemonade concentrate, 12 oz vodka, 12 oz beer (bottle landshark) and 12 oz sprite. No water. Everyone was asking for the recipe! New favorite drink...I highly recommend!!!

I have made this recipe a few times, but this time, instead of pink lemonade (didn't have it on hand) I doubled the recipe and used one 12oz can of lemonade and one 12oz can of limeade, then a total of three beers instead of two, along with the water and vodka. It was so good, nice and tart - not too sweet. Best "summer beer" drink I've had so far. Thanks for a great, flexible recipe!

I took credit for this, as though I came up with the idea myself, that's how YUMMY this is! I used Sprite instead of water to give the drink some fizz. We also added a pint of raspberries and sliced a lime for garnish. I have made this 4 times and have run out too early each time. AMAZING!!

I get requests for this at every summer barbecue. People love it. I definitely suggest trying different flavored vodkas. I've experimented and found making it with raspberry vodka is the best. I then garnish with fresh mixed berries.
My friends and I used to make this years ago but ours didn't have any water in it and it was made in the blender. We called it Skip and Go Nakeds.
It's a mighty tasty drink, but boy can it sneak up on you quick! I found it a better to mix 24-30oz of water instead of 12oz and Strawberry Guava juice is a nice substitute for the pink lemonade.
Refreshing have to try it to know
This was fantastic. I used citrus vodka, pink lemonade concentrate, and a Corona with about 1/3 of a lime squeezed in to it. Make sure you serve it with lots of ice, it's way better icy cold.
i love this drink. have been making for years. only difference i know it by a " Tunaville Trolley"
Great summer drink!
I made this for a crowd and it was a good alternative to a punch recipe but a bit too sweet for me.
Very impressed with how tasty this is. This will be our summer beverage of 2017.
This is my new favorite summer drink. Made it every weekend!

Fantastic! But just a warning, if you tell people ahead of time what is in it, most of them will make a funny face and be a bit leery about trying it. If you have them try it and then try and guess the ingredients, they won't believe you when you tell them the contents. This recipe sounds bizarre, even gross, but it goes down like lemonade and is a simple and inexpensive party drink!
Super delicious. I accidently got regular lemonade instead of pink lemonade but it was still good. Definitely will try with different vodkas, beers and flavored lemonade.
